page.title: Settings
page.description: Manage your account, security, notifications, and appearance.

currency.title: Default currency
currency.description: Used as the default when creating new accounts and for summary totals.

toasts.savedBody: New accounts and totals will use this currency.

password.title: Password
password.description: Change the password you use to sign in.
password.newHint: At least 8 characters with upper and lower case letters, a digit, and one of @$!%*?&.

validation.tooWeak: This password is too weak. Use at least 8 characters with upper and lower case letters, a digit, and a symbol.
validation.mustDiffer: Your new password must be different from your current one.

toasts.successBody: Use your new password the next time you sign in.
toasts.currentIncorrectBody: The current password you entered is wrong. Please try again.
toasts.errorBody: Something went wrong. Please try again later.

dangerZone.title: Danger zone
dangerZone.description: Irreversible actions that affect your entire account.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.description: Permanently delete your account and all associated data, including accounts, transactions, loans, and exports.
delete.warning: This action is permanent and cannot be undone. All of your data will be erased immediately.
delete.confirmBody: This will permanently erase your account and all of its data. This cannot be undone.
delete.passwordHint: Re-enter your password to confirm you want to delete your account.
delete.totpHint: Enter a current code from your authenticator app or a recovery code.

toasts.successBody: Your account and all of its data have been removed.
toasts.passwordIncorrectBody: We couldn't verify your password or code. Your account was not deleted.
toasts.errorBody: Something went wrong. Your account was not deleted. Please try again.

dataExport.title: Export your data
dataExport.description: Download your transactions and account data. Large exports are prepared in the background.

toasts.avatarSuccessBody: Your profile picture has been updated successfully.
toasts.avatarErrorFallback: Failed to update your profile picture. Please try again later.
toasts.validationErrorBody: Please check the form for errors.
toasts.profileSuccessBody: Your profile information has been saved successfully.
toasts.profileErrorFallback: Your profile information could not be updated. Please try again later.

language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the language used across the interface.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Choose what should trigger an in-app notification.

largeTransaction.title: Large transaction alert
largeTransaction.description: Notify when a transaction exceeds this amount.

lowBalance.title: Low account balance
lowBalance.description: Notify when any account balance drops below this amount.

toasts.savedBody: Your preferences will apply to new alerts.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.description: Add a second step at sign-in using an authenticator app (TOTP).

status.offDescription: Protect your account by requiring a one-time code at sign-in.
status.onDescription: A code from your authenticator app is required each time you sign in.

enroll.scanInstruction: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app (e.g. Google Authenticator, Aegis, 1Password).
enroll.manualInstruction: Can't scan? Enter this secret manually:
enroll.codeHint: Enter the 6-digit code shown in your app

disable.codeHint: Enter a current code or a recovery code to turn 2FA off

recovery.title: Save your recovery codes
recovery.description: Store these somewhere safe. Each code works once and lets you sign in if you lose your authenticator. They won't be shown again.
recovery.copiedBody: They're on your clipboard — store them somewhere safe.

toasts.enrollErrorBody: Please try again in a moment.
toasts.enabledBody: You'll be asked for a code the next time you sign in.
toasts.invalidCodeBody: That code is incorrect or has expired. Please try again.
toasts.disabledBody: Your account no longer requires a one-time code.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Pick how the app looks and the colour palette.
